name: Playwright MCP

demo.title: Let AI Explore Your Site & Write Tests with Playwright MCP!

what: Microsoft's MCP server that gives an AI agent a real browser via Playwright. It works from the page's structured accessibility snapshot instead of screenshots, so no vision model is needed.
who: Vibe coders and QA folks who want the agent to test their web app or automate web tasks.

setup.text: Add to your MCP client config:
Or via CLI: Claude Code / Codex:
setup.code:
claude mcp add playwright npx @playwright/mcp@latest
codex mcp add playwright npx "@playwright/mcp@latest"

setup.text: Optional flags include --headless, --isolated (in-memory profile) and --browser (chrome, firefox, webkit, msedge).
Using a coding agent? Microsoft notes that Playwright CLI + Skills (github.com/microsoft/playwright-cli) can be more token-efficient than the MCP server.

prompts: Open localhost:3000, sign up with a test email and tell me if anything breaks.
Go to my pricing page and check every link works.
Fill out the contact form on my site and report the confirmation message.
